title: Developer Documentation Assistant

blueprintSignals.name: API existence check
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Use the OpenAPI spec for the user's version

blueprintSignals.name: Snippet execution pass
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Run against the pinned SDK version in a test harness

blueprintSignals.name: Version match
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Read the version from request context, not from the question text alone

blueprintSignals.name: Citation supports the value
blueprintSignals.definition: the cited passage literally contains the stated value
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: A valid citation alone is not proof, because a changelog can cite both the old and the new value

blueprintSignals.name: Abstention precision
blueprintSignals.definition: share of declined questions that are truly unanswerable
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Needs labelled unanswerable questions kept out of tuning

label: For "Developer Documentation Assistant": Answer developer questions about APIs and SDKs with correct, version-specific code snippets and links to authoritative docs. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluating on questions from docs headings.
